description: Searches developer and tech roles that employers posted in the last 7 days, read directly from the employers' own hiring systems (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS and others) and checked daily. Covers 35 metro areas in the US and Canada (50-mile radius): Seattle, San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Chicago, Toronto, Boston, Los Angeles, Vancouver, Washington DC, Dallas-Fort Worth, Denver-Boulder, Austin, Atlanta, Phoenix, Philadelphia, Minneapolis-St. Paul, San Diego, Raleigh-Durham, Detroit, Houston, Charlotte, St. Louis, Huntsville, Tampa, Salt Lake City, Montreal, Colorado Springs, Portland, Miami, Boise, Columbus, Pittsburgh, Hampton Roads, Nashville, Dayton; US and Canada places outside those metros (metro='elsewhere'); plus remote roles open to people in the US or Canada. Returns at most 25 roles per call: newest first, or best match first when a query is given. Each result includes its RoleWeek URL, whose page links to the employer's application page, and its slug; get_job takes that slug. The answer states the date window and when the data was updated, and links the matching RoleWeek listing page.

metro.description: Metro area (50-mile radius), or 'remote' for roles open to people anywhere in the US or Canada.

min_salary.description: Yearly salary in the role's currency (USD in the US, CAD in Canada). Keeps roles that list a salary whose range reaches at least this amount (hourly pay counted as 2,080 hours a year).

no_account_needed.description: true: only roles whose hiring system RoleWeek checked and found the application form opens on the employer's own site with no account to create. Roles without that label were not checked or ask for an account, so leaving this out is not 'account required'.

posted_within_days.description: Only roles posted within this many days (1-7).

query.description: Keywords matched against title, company, skills and location, e.g. 'python', 'Stripe', 'rust kubernetes'. Every word must match.

role_family.description: Role family. 'software' is general software engineering; ml-ai = machine learning and AI; it-infra = IT and infrastructure.

seniority.description: One or more levels; entry = junior/new grad, staff-plus = staff, principal and above.

skill.description: Technology the role must list, by name: 'Rust', 'Python', 'Kubernetes', 'C++', 'Go' (nicknames such as golang or k8s work). Several names: the role must list every one. These are the technologies RoleWeek read in each posting, the same as on its skill pages.

work_mode.description: Only roles whose listing states this work mode (a role flagged remote counts as remote only, as on the site). Roles that state none are left out.

name: search_jobs
title: Search RoleWeek jobs
